Built **Neon Rumble**, a playable one-on-one fighting game in `index.html`.

- Fight an AI opponent in best-of-three rounds with health, timer, round wins, combos, and a special meter.
- Move with **← / →**, jump with **↑**, guard with **↓**, and attack with **J / K / L**.
- Includes touch controls for mobile, sound toggle, and a rematch option.

Assumption: this is a single-player arcade game against an AI fighter. I checked the JavaScript syntax and opened the game in a browser to verify the arena and fighters render.
